AC amendment: Per-test failure categorization in RED_CONFIRMATION note.

The RED_CONFIRMATION comment posted to ae31-ba7d-0861-4c27 must enumerate each test function and categorize its failure:
  (a) feature-not-implemented — expected RED, implementation story needed
  (b) environment/setup error — must be fixed before story closes (does not count toward DD9)
  (c) accidental pass — test assertion is too weak; must be tightened before story closes

Only tests in category (a) count toward confirming DD9 ('all tests confirmed RED before implementation begins'). Any category (b) or (c) results must be resolved by amending the failing test file (88de or 53d5 tasks) before 5532-989e is marked complete.

Updated Verify command for AC 'Story comment with RED_CONFIRMATION posted':
  .claude/scripts/dso ticket show ae31-ba7d-0861-4c27 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); comments=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'RED_CONFIRMATION' in c.get('body','')]; [print(c['body']) for c in comments]; exit(0 if comments else 1)"
